name: Languedoc, France

visa.notes: Long-stay visa requires ~€1,500/mo income. Must apply at French consulate. Renewable annually.

rent.notes: Pet-friendly 2-3BR house ~90 m2: median house rents Oct 2026 about 10.8 EUR/m2 Beziers, 13.1 Narbonne, 14.75 Herault dept (Montpellier-weighted); typical uses ~12 EUR/m2 plus small tenant charges.

sources.title: Trackstone - Prix immobilier et loyers Beziers
RealAdvisor - Prix immobilier Narbonne (loyers medians oct 2026)
RealAdvisor - Prix immobilier Herault (loyers medians oct 2026)

utilities.notes: Model: 4,500 kWh electricity at Tarif Bleu Base 0.2001 EUR/kWh + 190 EUR/yr (6 kVA) ~91/mo; ~6,000 kWh gas heating at ~0.15-0.158 EUR/kWh + 361 EUR/yr subscription ~105/mo; water+sewer ~30-35/mo (Montpellier 3.16 EUR/m3 used as regional proxy). Rural homes on fioul/pellets/electric heat vary. Internet excluded.

sources.title: Kelwatt - Tarif Bleu EDF au 1er aout 2026
Hello Watt - Prix repere gaz novembre 2026
Selectra - Prix de l'eau a Montpellier

healthcare.notes: PUMa base cover (cotisation subsidiaire CSM only if capital income exceeds 50% PASS; often 0 for pension-only households) + mutuelle for two at 60: Magnolia 60-64 medium 65-95/person, strong 82-125/person; Meilleurtaux Sept 2026 reinforced couple-60 average 248.82/mo, Mediterranean above average.

sources.title: LeComparateurAssurance - Prix de la mutuelle sante en 2026 (etude Meilleurtaux)

insurance.notes: OLD-TEMPLATE RULE: stored 150 was health insurance; re-modeled as renters (assurance habitation locataire) placeholder for a house, unverified. Full health cost now carried in healthcare.

taxes.notes: Estimated monthly income tax on $72,000/yr household income. Based on jurisdiction's effective retiree rate; excludes sales/VAT/property tax.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

healthcare.system: French Sécurité Sociale (Assurance Maladie) - world-class system. Residents get carte vitale after 3 months. CHU Montpellier is a major university hospital.
healthcare.waitTimes: GPs: same week. Specialists: 2-6 weeks. Shorter in Montpellier.
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: 70% covered by Sécu, remainder by mutuelle (supplemental insurance)

pros: Warm Mediterranean climate in southern France

pros.text: Montpellier is a vibrant university city with the TaM tram (4 lines, ~83 km — among the largest French tram networks outside Paris)

sources.title: TaM — Tramway de Montpellier (4 lines, ~83 km)

cons.text: French language essential for daily life
Smaller international community than Côte d'Azur
Safety & crime: see cited reports for current figures by city and country

taxes.notes: French progressive income tax 11%-45%. Social charges ~9.1% on foreign income (CSG/CRDS). US-France tax treaty.
